scientific_integrity: Original literature explicitly credited. All-parameter proof provided; 36 finite dynamical checks and 26 complete mod-two homology checks are corroborative only. No independent external mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Only two disjoint directed cycles, one empty vertex in each and outdegree-one simultaneous firing; no other initial configurations or multicycle generalization. Residual risk of unindexed stronger graph-operation literature.
title: The gcd sphere law for avalanche complexes of two independently firing directed cycles
